clue.text: Valet initially cut out to be a tax collector

clue.text: Safety valve in the market

clue.text: French art gallery in a modern residential area

clue.text: Time to identify one's opponents

the opposing side in a conflict

clue.text: Examine workers entering at will

explanation.definitionFit: A last will and testament is the legal document disposing of property after death.

clue.text: Organised system used by girl crossing ridge

clue.text: In time an African leader can become inactive
